name: The Dalaran Digest
summary: A librarian asks you to add magical works to the collection. Each book brings more knowledge to the library.

sections.title: The Collection
sections.body: The librarian welcomes magical works that may benefit the library. You bring one to add to the collection, and your efforts help its knowledge grow.

faq.answer: The librarian asks you to bring magical works that might benefit the collection.

faq.q: Where do I bring the book?
faq.answer: Bring it to the librarian who asks you to add to the collection.

faq.q: Why is the librarian collecting magical works?
faq.answer: The collection grows in knowledge through your contribution.
